newsitem.title: USA: Meredith sees dilution in FY98, FY99 from TV deal.
newsitem.headline: Meredith sees dilution in FY98, FY99 from TV deal.

text.p: Meredith Corp said Friday that its planned purchase of four television stations will be dilutive to earnings per share in fiscal 1998 and fiscal 1999.
Based on an anticipated closing date of mid-calendar 1997, the acquisition will have minimal impact on fiscal 1997 earnings, it added.
The company said it expects the deal to be accretive to earnings in fiscal 2000.
Earlier, Meredith said it agreed to acquire four television stations from First Media Television LP, a private company principally owned by the Marriott family.
The cash purchase price is $435 million, which Meredith said it will pay through a combination of cash and debt.
Meredith is a publishing and broadcasting company.
